title: Clearer access guidance
summary:
Special Bee request links gave way to clearer beta tier guidance and consistent tier wording.

The auth dashboard now describes Flower and Nectar access as limited during beta. The `gpt-image-1` access error points people to tier information instead of a removed request form.

The README, API docs, site news and agent guide now use tier-system wording in place of Special Bee references.

The Special Bee issue template, upgrade links and obsolete request files were removed. Published agent and workflow schemas now use `tier` instead of `special_bee`; the diff shows no change to tier eligibility or API request handling.
